sections.title: ASUS ZenBook 14X OLED
content: -Una batería que se agota demasiado rápido- es frustrante, ¿verdad? Aquí entra el ASUS ZenBook 14X OLED como solución definitiva. Este dispositivo ultraportátil maximiza tu día con su batería de larga duración y procesador Intel Core Ultra para eficiencia optimizada. Sumérgete visualmente gracias a su pantalla táctil OLED de ASUS Lumina y altavoces superlineales potentes. La conectividad sin esfuerzos está asegurada con puertos HDMI y Thunderbolt para expandir tu espacio visual profesionalmente sin complicaciones extra.
-Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 1550 dólares-. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: PREMIUM PORTABILITY - Go the extra mile with the remarkably sleek Zenbook 14 OLED — the ultimate ultraportable laptop. Seize every moment using the enhanced extended-life battery, amplify your efficiency with the top-tier Intel Core Ultra processor Series 2, and achieve seamless connectivity via all the essential ports. Immerse your senses in the vivid ASUS Lumina OLED touchscreen and powerful new Super-linear speakers, while embracing the eco-elegance of the environmentally conscious design

POWERFUL PERFORMANCE - Powered by Intel Core Ultra 9 285H processor, with 16 cores, achieving superior efficiency and speed, the integrated NPU AI supports artificial intelligence technology, and AI-based apps will run more smoothly. Equipped with 32GB of DDR5 RAM for seamless multitasking, and a 1TB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD for fast storage and reduced load times, ensuring smooth and responsive performance for all your tasks

CRISP DISPLAY & PRIVACY - Features a FHD IR webcam with privacy shutter for crystal-clear video calls and enhanced security, while the 14" WUXGA (1920 x 1200) OLED 500nits 100% DCI-P3 touchscreen display with Intel Arc graphics delivers crisp visuals, supported by the ability to connect 3 external monitors via HDMI and Thunderbolt 4 ports at 4K (3840x2160) @60Hz (without docking station)

VERSATILE CONNECTIVITY - Features a backlit keyboard for enhanced productivity. Equipped with 2 x Thunderbolt 4 (support for display / power delivery), USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A, HDMI 2.1 TMDS and an Audio combo jack for versatile connectivity. Includes Wi-Fi 7(802.11be) and Bluetooth 5.4 for fast, reliable wireless performance

OPERATING SYSTEM - Windows 11 Professional 64-bit, with AI-powered Copilot, offers intelligent assistance for a variety of tasks. Ideal for School Education, Designers, Professionals, Small Business, Programmers, Casual Gaming, Streaming, Online Class, Remote Learning, Zoom Meeting, Video Conference, etc
